with ranked as (
  select
    cast(task_id as varchar) as task_id,
    task_text,
    category,
    eff_sectors,
    n_occ_over_rca1,
    volume,
    row_number() over (
      partition by category
      order by volume desc
    ) as category_rank
  from jaat.AGGR_TaskAllocationCombinedTaskCategories
  where volume >= 10000
)
select
  task_id,
  task_text,
  category,
  eff_sectors,
  n_occ_over_rca1,
  volume
from ranked
where category_rank <= 20
order by
  case category
    when 'general' then 1
    when 'shared_cluster' then 2
    when 'specialized_core' then 3
    else 9
  end,
  volume desc

queries.compiledQueryString:
with occ as (
  select * from jaat.AGGR_TaskAllocationCombinedOccupationBurden
),
gap as (
  select
    count(*) as tasks_with_retained_noncanonical,
    sum(case when bucket = 'generic-diffusion' then 1 else 0 end) as generic_tasks,
    sum(case when bucket = 'mixed' then 1 else 0 end) as mixed_tasks,
    sum(case when bucket = 'sector-concentrated' then 1 else 0 end) as sector_concentrated_tasks
  from jaat.AGGR_TaskAllocationCombinedGapTasks
),
cat as (
  select
    count(*) as typed_tasks,
    sum(case when category = 'general' then 1 else 0 end) as general_labels,
    sum(case when category = 'shared_cluster' then 1 else 0 end) as cluster_labels,
    sum(case when category = 'specialized_core' then 1 else 0 end) as specialized_labels
  from jaat.AGGR_TaskAllocationCombinedTaskCategories
)
select
  count(*) as occupations,
  median(off_onet_share) as median_off_onet_share,
  sum(n_validated_offlist) as validated_offlist_pairs,
  sum(n_offlist_specialized_candidate_misfile) as specialized_candidate_misfiles,
  gap.tasks_with_retained_noncanonical,
  gap.generic_tasks,
  gap.mixed_tasks,
  gap.sector_concentrated_tasks,
  cat.typed_tasks,
  cat.general_labels,
  cat.cluster_labels,
  cat.specialized_labels
from occ
cross join gap
cross join cat
group by
  gap.tasks_with_retained_noncanonical,
  gap.generic_tasks,
  gap.mixed_tasks,
  gap.sector_concentrated_tasks,
  cat.typed_tasks,
  cat.general_labels,
  cat.cluster_labels,
  cat.specialized_labels
